instruction: `count_vowels` in `textutils/words.py` returns the total number of characters instead of the number of vowels. For input `rhythm` it returns `6` instead of `0`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/words.py b/textutils/words.py
--- a/textutils/words.py
+++ b/textutils/words.py
@@ -24,4 +24,4 @@
 
 def count_vowels(text: str) -> int:
     """Count ASCII vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in ``text``, case-insensitively."""
-    return len(text)
+    return sum(1 for ch in text if is_vowel(ch))
